notes.title: Update v0.49
notes.content:
Hello music lovers!

So after your votes there was a tie between Pop, Hip Hop and Rock. So we have added songs to each of them.

♫ Roll Like That by Ashley Jana Mounts added to Pop/Dance genre.
♫ The Man by Greame B. Samuels, Suzette Ferrell, Nigel Roberts, Silas Carty added to R&B/Hip Hop genre.
♫ Don't Give Up by Neil Cross added to Rock/Metal genre.
♫ Poll box reseted.

notes.title: Update v0.46
notes.content:
Hello music lovers!


With this update; 

♫ Audio VFX added for note misses.

♫ Notes not appearing correctly at "Idiocracy" song's master level bug fixed.

♫ Players with private Steam profile are also have private accounts ingame but leaderboard scores and
rankings are still visible.

♫ An icon will appear on leaderboard label if it is you.

♫ Performance improvements made.

notes.title: Update v0.35
notes.content:
Hello music lovers!


With this update; 

♫ Highest rating, max strike, highscore and max notes hit values are seperated by difficulty. Bad news is; these values and your unlocked songs are reseted. We are sorry about that but your online profile values like stats, achievements and leaderboard scores are protected.

♫ UI pop up for beat power collection added.

♫ Some song names not appearing correctly bug fixed.
